heading: Institutional Pedigree. Direct Access.
subhead: Our team brings decades of institutional investment-management experience to every client relationship — with the direct access and personal partnership that only a boutique firm can deliver.
closing: Decades of experience. One shared commitment.

members.name: Aaron J. Vann, AAMS, FPQP
members.title: Partner
members.bio: Aaron leads VEM's proprietary quantitative models and oversees portfolio construction and stock selection for the firm's equity SMAs. His career spans Rushmore Investment Advisors, Boston Private Bank, and Level Four Advisor Services.
members.credential: MBA Valedictorian · SMU Cox School of Business

members.name: Ryan McDonald
members.title: Portfolio Manager · Financial Planner
members.bio: Ryan brings 21+ years of financial-planning experience in North Texas, specializing in complex retirement and investment solutions. He builds around the individual — not a template.

members.name: Dharani Gundla
members.title: Financial Quantitative Analyst
members.bio: Dharani supports trading, performance analysis, and GIPS® composite maintenance. She manages compliance operations and risk analysis across equity and structured-note holdings.

members.name: Brandy Holder
members.title: Operations & Business Development · Financial Advisor
members.bio: Brandy supports Vann Equity Management's client service, operations, and compliance functions. She helps coordinate account administration, documentation, internal workflows, and regulatory processes to ensure clients receive organized, professional, and consistent service.
